steps: Created ReplicatedStorage.SiegeConfig ModuleScript: ObjectiveCenter, 4 named Breach portals, Intermission, and an ordered Waves table (breaches/perBreach/health/speed escalating).
Created ServerScriptService.SiegeDirector Script with a runtime enemy factory (self-contained Humanoid attacker, no external template) + simple converge AI.
Per wave: spawn attackers from the wave's active breach portals, wire Humanoid.Died to a countdown, and Wait a BindableEvent for wave-clear.
Drive lifecycle: system START -> per-wave intermission -> wave START -> spawns -> CLEARED -> final VICTORY, each printed with [Siege] tag.
Enemies die ONLY from ordinary Humanoid damage (player-level combat) - no auto-kill hook.
Verified both scripts compile, config loads (3 waves/4 breaches), SiegeDirector enabled, old RoundLoop stays disabled.

recipe.text: Fresh 'Breach Siege' concept distinct from prior flat ring-survival loops: attackers surge from NAMED breach portals that activate progressively per wave, converging on a central objective. Config-driven via ReplicatedStorage.SiegeConfig (waves reference breaches by name). SiegeDirector builds attackers at runtime, detects wave-clear via Humanoid.Died countdown, and prints [Siege]-tagged lifecycle events (System START, Intermission, Wave START, Spawn, Wave CLEARED, VICTORY) for observation. State mirrored on Workspace attributes. Enemies are killable by normal player combat; no gate-blocked auto-kill symbols.
